g.text: Register the writer in the subscriber map
The heartbeat exists because nginx closes an idle
proxied connection after 60 seconds. Without it the
stream dies quietly and the bell stops updating.
Emitting inside the transaction would announce
Increment the unread badge, prepend to the dropdown
Read the notifications newer than that id
Delivery is best-effort; the database is the record. The
bell reads the persisted list on load, so a notification
missed while offline is never lost, only delayed.
